labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: PhotoCraft is an open source photo and image editor written from scratch in Rust, part of the ArtCraft suite: layers, masks, adjustment layers, filters and raw import in a fast native interface.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Photocraft

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:ubunturesolute

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE=PhotoCraft \
    NO_GAMEPAD=true \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/storytold/photocraft/main/assets/app-icon/hicolor/256x256/apps/ai.storyteller.photocraft.png && \
  echo "**** install photocraft ****" && \
  if [ -z ${PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/storytold/photocraft/releases/latest" \
      | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/photocraft.deb -L \
    "https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/releases/download/${PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE}/photocraft-${PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE#v}-linux-x86_64.deb" && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    libegl1 \
    xdg-desktop-portal \
    xdg-desktop-portal-gtk \
    /tmp/photocraft.deb && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/* \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001

VOLUME /config

notes.upstream:
## What's Changed
* fix(ui): keep the Color Sampler cursor while a sampler is dragged (#13063) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13212
* fix(ui): the Arbitrary angle rounds in f64 and keeps that value (#13067) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13217
* Remove tool: 19 px brush after Reset Tool and on first use by @rmsff in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13151
* Release: PhotoCraft v0.23.0 on main by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13345
* Remove: alert on a pixel layer with Lock All by @rmsff in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13171
* Pen: Undo after finishing a path gives it back to the Pen instead of deleting it (#6619) by @marmitoTH in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6413
* ci: use StepSecurity's maintained actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13337
* macOS signing: decode the certificate into an exclusive temp file by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11028
* Place: refuse a scale that makes the placed image exceed the render pixel limit by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11229
* automation: save_bytes never reads linked files by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11233
* Escape control characters in log lines and diagnostic output taken from files and plug-ins by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11218
* text: charge the rasterizer's output tiles, not only its pixels by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11047
* fix(engine): apply the metadata choice to WebP Quick Export by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11058
* fix(compose): bisect gradient stops, evict oversized effect maps, skip empty distance transforms by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11056
* Camera Raw: read each source row once when building the preview proxy by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11064
* fix(cms): charge decoded CLUT values against a per-profile budget by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11055
* Save: a replacement in another group does not widen group access by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11232
* fix(ui-egui): bound the RAW re-read and treat symlinked names as taken in batch export by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11204
* fix(algo): hold raw filter parameters to their ranges (Water Paper, Box Blur, Lanczos, Camera Raw noise) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11199
* fix(algo): bound EXIF text decoding, warp scans, gallery windows, inpaint sizes, pyramid depth by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11161
* codecs: list each Cryptomatte layer once and index streams by name by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10978
* fix(gpu): cap plan accumulator slots and gradient lookup tables by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11061
* fix(io): charge importers for the whole tiles surfaces keep by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11144
* fix(format,engine): limit zstd windows, set bundle modes via the handle, refuse symlinked presets by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11145
* fix(codecs): checked sizes in encoders, EXR name lookup, FITS float limit, VP8 plane copies, EXIF thumbnail bytes by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11164
* fix(engine): bound sparse remap, scaled clone sources, path reads, export format, name lookups by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11181
* fix(engine): authorization for nested scratch sessions and preset calls, CSV and PostScript text escaping by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11188
* Actions: charge skipped steps to the playback budget, bound batch nesting, clip the set override by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10969
* Engine: check dense working buffers against a budget before expanding sparse content by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10964
* paint: refuse a sequential-dab stroke whose working copy is too large by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11070
* CI: nightly release dry run by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13374
* Zoom tool: Zoom In / Zoom Out mode buttons (#12066) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13013
* Delete Anchor Point: Alt-click on an anchor selects its whole subpath by @rmsff in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13188
* Convert Point: drag a segment as Direct Selection does by @rmsff in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13141
* Freeform Pen: close a stroke only within 3 px of its start on each axis by @rmsff in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13313
* Line tool: Weight 1 px and 5 × 10 px arrowheads by default and after Reset Tool (#13241) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13305
* Count tool options bar: every control from the start in the reference order, tooltips and greying, scrubby size captions (#11765) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/12206
* paint: two stroke tests check the result the stroke now returns by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13378
* Polygon tool: a rounded star rounds only its outer points (#13308) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13342
* Type options bar: Toggle Character and Paragraph panels button by @slafebre in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13020
* Line tool: a drag is one History step named "Line Tool" (#13244) by @NaufalDzz in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13303
* Delete Anchor Point keeps its path on the first Escape, and leaves a drag alone (#13072) by @Raghav2012Code in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13176
* Add Anchor Point: an anchor added to a straight segment is smooth, with handles (#12706) by @TrevorBrown-dev in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13215
* fix(ui): a Perspective Crop drag with no area keeps the clicked corners (#13065) by @Raghav2012Code in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13234
* ci: cap headless GPU backend tests with the nextest gpu group by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13257
* Perspective Crop: W, H and Resolution clamp to the measured ranges with alerts by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/12237
* Fix Flatpak updates and bump to 0.23.1 by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13322


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/compare/v0.23.0...v0.23.1
